title: Relative very ampleness in the projective-bundle convention
statement: Let $f:Y\to X$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] and let $L$ be an $\mathcal O_Y$-module. Say $L$ is relatively very ample over $X$ if there exist a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module $E$ [pqf-def-coherent] and an immersion $i:Y\to P_X(E)$ [def-weil-closed-immersion] over $X$ such that $i^*\mathcal O_{P_X(E)}(1)\cong L$, using tensor pullback [def-pc-module-pullback]. Here $P_X(E)$ is the relative Proj of the canonical symmetric graded algebra [def-trf-canonical-symmetric-graded-algebra], and $\mathcal O(1)$ is its canonical degree-one invertible twist with normalized tautological quotient as in [lem-trf-projective-bundle-quotient-geometry]; in particular $L$ is invertible [def-sc-invertible-module]. No finite-type or local-freeness hypothesis on $E$, or quasi-compactness hypothesis on $f$, is imposed.

source.place: Tag 01VM, definition-very-ample; projective bundle and twist from Constructions Tag 01OB and quotient geometry Tag 01OA.
